brief.scope: Adjudicate the seven Claude findings on GPT-6's lane-enforcement PLAN; you produced neither. Read plan, owner brief and both review inputs. Rule each UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED with current-source evidence, then identify a bounded first contract. Verify especially policy authority versus environment overrides, job-output ownership/cycles, stale doctrine buckets and existing laneconf/conformance gates. Assess proposed shortcuts: missing declarations must not widen grants; deferring land/ladder cannot create an acceptance bypass; verify the claim that git status -uall observes ignored files rather than assume it. Preserve configurable profiles, distinct infrastructure lane, truthful containment limits and permanent dev/prod independence. No broad audit or implementation design. Return concise RULING as an envelope artifact string, including essential corrections and first contract scope. Read-only: no source/tests/settings/host/DB/network edits or vendor launches.

findings.claim: UPHELD. Policy authority resolved through laneconf is silently relocatable: conf_path() takes LANE_CONF, values() overlays every declared key from the environment, and get() returns os.environ ahead of the file. NAME_KEYS blocks only lane.local.conf identity keys and does not stop that overlay, including for NAME_KEYS themselves. A new LANE_POLICY_PATH key is uncovered. Admit ops/lane-policy.json from the repository root and captured git ref/digest; do not resolve policy through laneconf.get. Profiles remain mapping keys in that document. record.lane and WF_LANE stay the infrastructure marker.

findings.claim: PARTIAL. E5 must not own declared job outputs or per-harness adapter grants; those belong to the launch/task contract, and lane policy consumes them as one intersection term so neither track is the other's prerequisite. The proposed fallback to profile roots when a declaration is absent is REJECTED: missing declarations must not widen grants. An absent launch-track declaration adds no write root. Read roles stay snapshot-immutable except a declared out/ the adapter can isolate.

findings.claim: PARTIAL. Twenty-one buckets with mandatory binding only at E15 is not the smallest protection of today's dispatcher. Deferring land/ladder without a rule is an acceptance bypass: land accepts envelope-not-ok when collection verifies, and ladder accepts closed+ok, so unbound or collected work can still land. First delivery must bind and check settle, write-resume and collect, and land/ladder must treat missing or mismatched policy evidence as non-acceptance. Instruction-digest pinning, hooks, doctor, MCP and jobs.json capability rows may wait. Worker verdict, CLI exit 0 and collect-verify cannot accept.

artifacts.RULING:
RULING at 23c5324b40a84366cf5bb68a1132e262ca9b21cc against c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc. Artifact: GPT-6 PLAN in in/20260906T013410Z-plan-codex-670fff.json. Reviews: Claude 9e9fa3 (seven findings) and consolidation review b0e12f. This adjudicator produced neither. Inputs sha256-equal to record.json brief.inputs. No source/tests/settings/host/DB/network edits; no vendor launch; suites not run.

F1 P1 policy-via-laneconf — UPHELD. F2 P2 E5/jobs.json — PARTIAL (ownership UPHELD; profile-root fallback REJECTED). F3 P2 D1-D3 stale — UPHELD. F4 P2 21 buckets / A1-A5 — PARTIAL (size UPHELD; land/ladder deferral without refuse-if-unbound REJECTED). F5 P2 laneconf closure/literals — UPHELD of the PLAN as written. F6 P3 registry sequencing — UPHELD of the PLAN as written. F7 P3 -uall — PARTIAL (reuse _residual_entries UPHELD; -uall-sees-ignored REJECTED).

Admitted: no Symfony word-ban; no prompt/classifier as semantic enforcement; nested brief.policy beside infrastructure lane (record.py:25,79); refuse flag/spec conflict; write-resume and collect are extra acceptance holes; third profile by data only; permanent dev/prod independence; claude/grok containment is policy (launch.py:379-381; CLAUDE_DENIED_TOOLS has no Write/Edit).

ESSENTIAL CORRECTIONS. (1) Policy document at fixed tracked path ops/lane-policy.json; authority is admitted git ref plus digest, not LANE_CONF, LANE_POLICY_PATH, environment or lane.local.conf. NAME_KEYS cannot fix this because values()/get() overlay the environment anyway. (2) Launch/task owns output and adapter grants; lane policy intersects; absence does not widen. (3) Do not re-edit D1-D3 homes already corrected in 7e07a13. (4) Land/ladder refuse missing or mismatched policy evidence; no E15-only activation; no acceptance by worker verdict, exit 0 or collect-verify alone. (5) Honest containment: claude/grok detection at acceptance, not harness prevention. (6) Residual check consumes existing _residual_entries, including ls-files --ignored.

FIRST CONTRACT (S; C owns; T then I later; no implementation here). Files: ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; ops/lane-policy.json; coupling paragraph in ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md covering consume-if-present outputs, brief.policy binding, settle/write-resume/collect, and land/ladder refuse-if-unbound. No jobs.json schema ownership. No lane.conf key. Later evaluator: ops/conductor/tools/lane_policy.py, stdlib, repo-root path, no CLI, no instrument-conventions.md docstring, no profile-id literals.

The contract must state: profile ids as mapping keys and an explicit default only if configured; permitted write roots; forbidden dependency roots; protected authority paths; shared reads; refusal classes lane-profile, lane-policy, lane-write, lane-dependency, lane-artifact, lane-resume on the docs/wire.md line; candidate policy bytes cannot self-authorize; unknown, empty or conflicting selection refuses; environment, scope text and inputs cannot reclassify; third synthetic profile by configuration data only.

Acceptance: P1 ops/ writes plus shared-doc/Symfony references pass on the dev profile. P2 the same writes on prod pass, including Composer; they refuse under dev. P3 a third profile by data only, consumers unchanged. N1 missing/unknown/conflict refuses before a child starts. N2 env, LANE_CONF and a resume prompt cannot move authority or profile. N3 product writes, vendor/autoload.php or bin/console under dev refuse. N4 ignored and untracked product writes are caught via existing residual entries. N5 status ok, verdict approve, exit 0 and collect-verify cannot override. N6 a missing output declaration grants no extra write. R1 a stationary binding revalidates. R2 changed policy, profile or template refuses before attempt markers move. R3 land/ladder treat missing policy evidence as non-acceptance.
